required_identity.target: pi^-4 absorption identity at C6 level
expanded_requirements: The coexact transverse determinant supplies T_coex^RP3 with positive tower multiplicities.
The bosonic determinant and volume normalization supply Vol(RP3)/2 = pi^2/2.
The second-order determinant expansion supplies the minus sign in 1 - N/(24*S_geo).
The scalar/ghost Casimir branch supplies the universal factor 1/(24*S_geo).
The admissible mixed insertion is P02, so Tr(P02)=10 and not the full scalar tower.
The remaining nonintegral gap N_need-10 is explained by a derived finite local scheme residue, or else the identity is not exact.

trace_tests.needed_formula: delta^2 Gamma = -1/4 Tr((Delta^{-1} delta Delta)^2) plus ghost/exact corrections, reducible to the model's -N/(24*S_geo) sign convention
trace_tests.why: The sign is standard in logdet expansion, but the combined Maxwell--ghost reduced operator has not been written explicitly.

trace_tests.needed_formula: integral over RP3 of the normalized local insertion gives Vol(RP3)=pi^2; bosonic logdet gives 1/2
trace_tests.why: The factors are natural but not yet derived from normalized eigenfunctions and measure conventions.

trace_tests.needed_formula: Tr over admissible first-strain insertion space equals dim Sym^2(R4)=10
trace_tests.why: This follows if and only if the insertion space is first ambient strain rather than generic internal metric variations.

trace_tests.needed_formula: P02 is applied before scalar/exact spectral summation; ell>=4 are higher ambient strains outside II.A
trace_tests.why: Already supported by first-strain selection, but not a theorem of ordinary Maxwell theory.

trace_tests.needed_formula: N_need - 10 = 0.0099700224 is derived as a finite scheme residue, omitted subleading determinant term, or proven irrelevant under the target precision rule
trace_tests.why: With current exact Bessel tail and rank 10, the equality is not exact; relative pi^-4 mismatch is 3.04e-6.

verdict: C6 is now localized: the missing proof is the explicit second variation of the gauge-fixed Maxwell--ghost determinant under first ambient strain. P02 rank 10 is conditionally derived, but the volume factor, combined sign, det-prime bookkeeping, and N_need-10 scheme gap remain open.
